close_reason: Already fixed: apply_jmap_patch line 1695 already has comment 'Parent absent and value is null: nothing to remove — no-op'.
description: tests/common/mod.rs apply_jmap_patch: when a path-style key names a non-existent parent object and the value is null, nothing happens (no error, no insertion). This is correct per RFC 8620 §5.3 JSON Merge Patch semantics: null removes, so if the parent does not exist there is nothing to remove. A future contributor might add an error return for the absent-parent+null case, which would cause legal patches like 'mailboxIds/<non-existent-id>: null' to fail when the sub-key was already absent.
title: apply_jmap_patch treats absent-parent + null value as no-op
